name: Nemtly Booking
author: sapayth

sections.description:
Nemtly Booking transforms your WordPress site into a powerful event and appointment booking platform. Built with performance and usability in mind, this plugin provides an intuitive interface for creating events, managing bookings, and handling availability.

Key Features

Event Management
* Create and manage events with detailed information
* Set event dates, times, and capacity limits
* Customize event descriptions and settings
* Manage recurring events and availability

Booking System
* Seamless booking forms for users
* Real-time availability checking
* Booking confirmation and notifications

Admin Interface
* Intuitive event and booking management
* Statistics and reporting tools
* User-friendly interface for non-technical users

Frontend Integration
* Shortcode support for easy embedding
* Responsive design for all devices
* Customizable booking forms
* Seamless theme integration

Perfect For

  • Event Organizers – Manage workshops, conferences, and meetups
  • Service Providers – Handle appointment bookings for consultations
  • Fitness Studios – Schedule classes and personal training sessions
  • Educational Institutions – Organize courses and training programs
  • Small Businesses – Manage customer appointments and consultations

Why Choose Nemtly Booking

  • Responsive Design – Works perfectly on desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Performance Optimized – Fast loading and efficient resource usage
  • SEO Friendly – Clean URLs and proper meta tags
  • Accessibility – WCAG compliant for inclusive user experience

Easy Setup

  1. Install & Activate – Upload and activate the plugin
  2. Create Events – Add your first event through the admin panel
  3. Embed Forms – Use shortcodes to display booking forms
  4. Start Booking – Your users can now book appointments

Mobile Ready

Nemtly Booking is fully responsive and works seamlessly across all devices. Whether your users are booking from desktop, tablet, or mobile, they’ll have a smooth, intuitive experience.

Customizable

  • Customize booking form fields
  • Adjust colors and styling to match your brand
  • Configure email notifications
  • Set up custom booking rules and availability

Secure & Reliable

  • Built with WordPress security best practices
  • Regular updates and maintenance
  • Data validation and sanitization
  • Secure booking process

Support

  • Support Forum: WordPress.org Support

Credits

Built with ❤️ using WordPress and modern web technologies.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Nemtly Booking”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Post-Installation Setup

  1. Navigate to Nemtly Booking in your admin menu
  2. Create your first event
  3. Configure booking settings
  4. Add booking forms to your pages using shortcodes
sections.faq:
What are the minimum requirements?

WordPress 5.8 or higher and PHP 7.4 or higher. The plugin works with any properly coded WordPress theme.

Can I customize the booking form?

Yes! You can customize form fields, styling, and behavior through the admin settings.

Does it work with my theme?

Absolutely. Nemtly Booking is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme and follows WordPress standards.

Can I set up recurring events?

Yes, you can create recurring events with flexible scheduling options.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive and works perfectly on all devices.

Can I export booking data?

Yes, you can export booking data and reports through the admin interface.

Does it support multiple time zones?

Yes, the plugin handles time zones properly for global events.

Can I use it for free events?

Yes, the plugin works for both free and paid events.
